info.title: Facturac bounded catalogue service-create command
info.description: Normative Phase 5B design only; no endpoint implemented or external enablement authorized. Read the governing Phase 5B contract and its CS1 extension. Exactly one new non-stock service-create capability.

parameters.name: workspacePublicId
parameters.description: Explicit credential-bound ULID; either case accepted, canonical lowercase. Foreign/nonexistent context has identical denial.

parameters.name: entityPublicId
parameters.description: Explicit credential-bound ULID; either case accepted, canonical lowercase. Foreign/nonexistent context has identical denial.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: Homologation denied before catalogue service/default/ledger lookup. Cannot override binding.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque case-sensitive HTTP field value after standard outer OWS removal. Whitespace-only invalid. Printable ASCII, comma literal, not a list. Reject detectable duplicate fields; infrastructure must preserve one field. Random UUID recommended, not required. Never log raw value.

post.summary: Create one non-stock catalogue service or replay its original acknowledgement
post.description: Requires current machine identity, catalogue:services:create in BOTH credential and parent, explicit production context and current original owner/administrator sponsor with verified email and configured/confirmed MFA. Revalidated under PostgreSQL locks on creation AND replay.

201.description: New creation and authorized completed replay both return 201 with byte-identical stored JSON. No Location or live catalogue service representation.

X-Request-ID.description: Required fresh server UUID, including replay.

Cache-Control.description: Required no-store and private directives; either order.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Required false on first success, true on replay.

IntegrationBearer.description: Existing hashed credentials. Bearer validity alone is insufficient. No wildcard, sessions, cookies or delegation.

code.description: ASCII edge trim and uppercase before validation. Unique within entity across products/services and active/inactive records.

name.description: NFC and ASCII SP/HT/CR/LF edge trim; normalized 1–255 Unicode code points, no remaining C0/C1 controls. Case and internal spacing retained.

description.description: NFC and ASCII SP/HT/CR/LF edge trim; normalized 1–255 Unicode code points, no remaining C0/C1 controls. Case and internal spacing retained. Omission stores null; supplied null or empty rejects.

unit_of_measure.description: Omission defaults to UN. ASCII edge trim and uppercase; bounded free unit label, not a registry identifier.

unit_price_minor.description: Canonical integer minor-unit string, inclusive maximum 9223372036854775807 enforced by length/lexical comparison before casting. Scale two; pre-tax base supply price. No JSON number, float, rounding or FX.

currency_code.description: Exact token. On first effect must match locked entity base currency and enabled currency configuration; incompatible entity configuration gives generic 503. Replay does not read current defaults.

tax_treatment.description: Exact frozen token. New effect resolves the authoritative SupportedTaxTreatment profile and verifies the pinned components; drift gives generic 503. No raw tax component fields or legal/homologation assurance.

x-request-boundary.duplicateJsonMembers: reject after decoding member names, before lossy conversion
x-request-boundary.normalization: x-normalized-schema is normative post-normalization validation, in addition to wire schema. See contract.

x-unsupported-methods.recognizedEnabledPath: IP quota, bearer, verified quotas and scope/context denial ordering before 405; no body validation/key reservation/domain lookup. HEAD suppresses every error body.

x-idempotency.canonicalJson: Typed normalized command/context/principal/defaults version, sorted object keys, deterministic UTF-8 escaping, no floats. Golden vectors required.
x-idempotency.precommitFailure: atomic rollback, authorized retry may claim
x-idempotency.uncertainCommit: retry same key/payload, never automatically execute again

x-quotas.window: native fixed 60 seconds; adjacent-window burst permitted
x-quotas.capacityScope: 100000 combined retained successes per stable integration, not per command

x-transaction.database: primary PostgreSQL 18; SQLite fast tests only; MySQL external command denied
atomic: one complete non-stock catalogue service row
x-transaction.newServiceEffectLock: Bound legal entity FOR SHARE after common context locks, held through commit; no new domain/default lock on completed replay.

x-error-order: Disabled -> IP quota -> media/size -> bearer -> verified quotas -> preliminary sponsor/scope/context -> method/path/query/correlation/key/body -> attempted audit -> locked authorization -> idempotency -> domain/result/audit. Earlier generic faults take precedence; no business lookup before context authorization.

x-domain.domainUniqueness: existing legal_entity_id + code across all catalogue types and active states; not an upsert
